Because B2M_HA_L retains the native 5'-UTR and ATG (44711547), any sense read-through transcript initiating at the endogenous B2M promoter carries a 60-aa uORF in Arm 1A (construct pos 739..921, peptide MSRSVALAVLALLSLSGLEAMLRCPSVGRAHIAHSPREVGGRGRQLNRCLEKVARGKLGK*, with 2 internal sense ATGs inside the uORF and 0 after the stop codon before the HLA-E SCT Kozak ATG at 1173) or a 21-aa uORF in Arm 1B (construct pos 539..604, peptide MSRSVALAVLALLSLSGLEAI*, followed by 11 intervening sense ATGs [10 across the antisense CD47-EEF1A1 cassette at 613..1457 plus 1 at 1574..1576 inside Syn_5xISRE_minP_148bp_sense upstream of the internal TSS at 1596] before the HLA-E SCT Kozak ATG at 1647). IMPORTANT STRAND ORIENTATION NOTE: In Arm 1B, SV40_late_polyA_122bp_antisense (parts[1], 601..722, orientation '-') is oriented on the antisense (-) strand to terminate the convergent antisense CD47 transcript and does NOT terminate sense-strand (+) transcription from the endogenous B2M promoter. Consequently, endogenous B2M promoter read-through is NOT credited for productive HLA-E translation; sense HLA-E transcription in Arm 1B initiates exclusively from the internal sense promoter Syn_5xISRE_minP_148bp_sense (and from EEF1A1_core_promoter_230bp in Arm 1A), whose 5' leaders contain zero upstream ATGs before the HLA-E Kozak start (closes AUDIT-REF, 022, & AUDIT-REF).

second_order_gzmb_capture_kinetics_and_n.gzmm_mediated_serpinb9_cleavage_inactiva: NK-enriched Granzyme M (GzmM, Met-ase/Leu-ase) not only cleaves nucleophosmin and alpha-tubulin independently of SERPINB9, but directly cleaves the SERPINB9 (PI-9) reactive-center loop as a non-inhibitory substrate to generate an inactive ~40-kDa cleaved serpin species, accelerating depletion of functional cytosolic SERPINB9 during NK degranulation (Mahrus et al. 2004 J Biol Chem PMID:15494398; AUDIT-REF & L2-B).

serpinb9_rcl_vicinal_cys341_cys342_redox.primary_citation: Mangan et al. 2016 J Biol Chem PMID:26670609
serpinb9_rcl_vicinal_cys341_cys342_redox.oxidative_inactivation_mechanism: SERPINB9 contains a vicinal Cys341-Cys342 dyad at P1'-P2' of its reactive-center loop (337-VVAECCMES-345) immediately C-terminal to the P1=Glu340 cleavage residue. Under inflammatory ROS/H2O2, Cys341-Cys342 forms a reversible vicinal disulfide bond that constrains RCL conformation and abolishes Granzyme B inhibition (Mangan et al. 2016 PMID:26670609). Layer 4 interstitial catalase (keeping [H2O2]_max <= 10 uM) and TXNIP-/- thioredoxin preservation mitigate cytosolic oxidation, and the redox-resistant SERPINB9(C341S/C342S) RCL variant is pre-registered as a Stage-0 Gate 0C-kinetic oxidative-stress challenger (AUDIT-REF & L2-B).

second_order_gzmb_capture_kinetics_and_n.non_gzmb_granzyme_and_death_ligand_scope: SERPINB9 (PI-9) is a specific suicide inhibitor of Granzyme B (reactive-center P1=Glu340) and does not inhibit tryptase/chymase-like Granzyme A, Granzyme K, or Granzyme M (which is inhibited by SERPINB4 and cleaves SERPINB9; Mahrus et al. 2004 PMID:15494398; de Koning et al. 2011 PMID:21857942) or extrinsic FasL/TRAIL -> Caspase-8 signaling; upstream NK/CTL degranulation suppression therefore relies on Arm 1B/1X/B'-SCT inhibitory receptor engagement (CD94/NKG2A, KIR2DL1/2/3, SIRPa, PD-L1) and peri-graft SA-FasL/SA-THBD microgels, while Gate 0C-kinetic measures net primary NK/CTL Annexin-V+/Caspase-3/7 apoptosis in the presence and absence of selective GzmB inhibitor Compound 20 / Z-AAD-CMK to partition GzmB vs GzmA/M/FasL residual death.

Bernoulli(0.15) breakthrough is 0.581642 (58.16%, > 8%); and (4) if synaptic hits are spatially correlated across the 12 pulses (e.g. 15% border cells hit every pulse while 85% interior cells are never hit, giving the same marginal p = 0.15), population breakthrough is 15.0% even from 0.89 uM. twelve_pulse_hypoxic_coupon_reconciliati.reconciliation_rule: Explicitly reconciles the 6-pulse vs 12-pulse serial GzmB ODE envelopes under hypoxic ISR translation attenuation (f_ISR = 0.45 at pO2 = 8-12 mmHg, k_d = ln(2)/6 h^-1, SI = 1.0): if every 2-h NK/CTL contact injected a full unattenuated 0.15 uM cytosolic GzmB bolus, intracellular L3-BF-B SERPINB9 alone would provide a 6-pulse autonomous intracellular buffer from a pre-loaded 0.89 uM IFN-gamma state before exhausting at Pulse 7 (0.0599 uM unneutralized GzmB; and at Pulse 4 from a hypoxia-equilibrated 0.4005 uM start [0.038049 uM unneutralized; pre-pulse 0.111951 uM] or Pulse 2 from the 0.30 uM Hour-0 basal floor under unprimed f_ISR = 0.45 [0.003094 uM unneutralized; vs Pulse 3 under normoxic f_ISR = 1.0 with 0.063549 uM unneutralized]), because steady-state 2-h resynthesis under f_ISR = 0.45 replaces at most 0.4005 * (1 - exp(-2*ln(2)/6)) = 0.0826 uM per 2-h interval (< 0.15 uM). common_mode_epigenetic_silencing_and_en_.per_cell_vs_per_graft_common_mode_parame: Distinguishes two distinct common-mode parameters (AUDIT-REF [DEC-046]): (a) Layer-2 p_common_cell in [10^-6, 10^-5] is a per-proliferating-cell trans-epigenetic/apoptotic resistance rate (giving p_cell = p_common_cell + (1 - p_common_cell)*10^-8, expected surviving proliferating cells E = 93,350 * p_cell = 0.0943 to 0.9344 per dose, and Poisson dose-level escape probability P(>=1 survivor) = 1 - exp(-E) = 8.9975% to 60.7192%, which exceeds the 0.1% patient-level target by 90x-607x); whereas (b) Layer-1 q_common_graft <= 6.6998e-5 is a per-graft/per-batch catastrophic failure probability in P_escape_graft = q_common_graft + (1 - q_common_graft)*(1 - (1 - p_cell)^93350) <= 10^-3, which at q_common_graft = 6.6998e-5 matches the 10^-3 total dose-level ceiling when per-cell escape is at the two-independent-allele floor p_cell = p_ind^2 = 10^-8 (leaving remaining cell-level headroom p_cell <= 1.00000094e-8, i.e. p_common_cell <= 9.4e-16 when q_common_graft = 6.6998e-5 is simultaneously active, whereas under a pure cell-level budget q_common_graft = 0 the 10^-3 dose-level ceiling allows p_cell <= 1.0718e-8, i.e. per-cell p_common_cell <= 7.18e-10; DEC-078). This 90x-607x gap under realistic per-cell trans-silencing is why pharmacological suicide switches (iCasp9 / RQR8) cannot be claimed as a standalone <= 10^-3 patient-level guarantee and why primary physical containment + en-bloc surgical retrievability (Gate 0S-Retrieval) is mandatory.

dual_orthogonal_suicide_switch_challenge.why_gate_0s_surgical_retrieval_remains_m: Even with an orthogonal second suicide switch (RQR8/rituximab or HSV-TK/ganciclovir) at a second safe harbor, a 5e8-cell total graft still has E=5.0 surviving cells (P(>=1)=99.33%) at a 10^-8 per-cell escape ceiling and 0.0943-0.9344 expected proliferating escapees across the 93,350 pan-lineage Ki67+ subpopulation under p_common = 10^-6-10^-5 (plus macromolecular IgG/complement diffusion limits inside a fibrotic capsule for RQR8); therefore pharmacological suicide switches serve as >=4-5 log debulking adjuncts while primary physical containment and en-bloc surgical retrievability of the dual omental pouches (Gate 0S-Retrieval) provide the definitive clinical fail-safe (AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF [DEC-044/045]).

common_mode_epigenetic_silencing_and_en_.primary_containment_and_surgical_retriev: Because both alleles of biallelic AAVS1::cHS4-A2UCOE-EEF1A1-iCasp9 (or dual-safe-harbor AAVS1 + GAPDH) reside inside the same trans-acting nuclear DNMT3A/3B/KAP1/HUSH and post-mitotic beta-cell XIAP/BCL-xL environment, single-cell AP1903 escape follows the common-mode mixture model P_escape_cell = p_common + (1 - p_common) * p_ind^2 rather than a pure independent product p_ind^2 = 10^-8 (Wunderlich et al. 2022 PMID:35795779; Ordovas et al. 2015 PMID:26455413). er_heavy_chain_flux_and_upr_hazard_muse_.mechanism: In B2M-/- cells where the only beta-2-microglobulin is intramolecularly tethered inside the HLA-E*01:03 SCT via a 15-aa (G4S)3 linker, endogenous HLA-A, HLA-B, and HLA-C promoters remain intact and highly inducible by IFN-gamma/IFN-alpha via conserved ISRE/GAS elements, synthesizing orphan MHC-I heavy chains that cannot assemble with free beta2m and are retained in the ER membrane bound to calnexin/BiP until cleared by HRD1/SEL1L-dependent ER-associated degradation (ERAD; Spiliotis et al. 2002 PMID:12006653).

synthesis_and_erad_steady_state_bounds.formula_reconciliation_note_kimi31_r4: Exact steady-state mass-action formulas: F_synth = N_WT * (ln(2) / (t_1/2,WT * 60)) * I_IFN and S_ER,retained = F_synth * t_1/2,ERAD / ln(2) = N_WT * I_IFN * (t_1/2,ERAD / (t_1/2,WT * 60)). At resting turnover t_1/2,WT = 12 h (720 min), [Low: N=100k, I=6x, t_ERAD=30 min], [Central: N=200k, I=10x, t_ERAD=60 min], and [High: N=300k, I=15x, t_ERAD=60 min] give F_synth = [577.6, 1925.4, 4332.2] molecules/min and S_ER,retained = [25,000, 166,667, 375,000] molecules/cell (whereas 200,000 is the rounded central reference and 8,664.3 molecules/min -> 750,000 molecules/cell corresponds to inflammatory accelerated MHC-I turnover t_1/2,WT = 6 h; AUDIT-REF).

er_heavy_chain_flux_and_upr_hazard_muse_.cis_tethered_hlae_sct_cannot_chaperone_o: Intramolecularly tethered HLA-E SCT (Arm 1A / Arm 1C) has its single B2M domain covalently linked 1:1 in cis to its own HLA-E heavy chain (effective local concentration > 10 mM) and supplies zero free soluble B2M in trans to rescue endogenous orphan HLA-A/B/C heavy chains; therefore, if Gate 0E-ER fails on B2M-/- clones, valid biological ERAD-reduction pivots are: (1) pair with TYK2 P1104A (which suppresses Type-I-IFN HLA-A/B/C transcription by 80-90% in the iPSC-beta knockdown branch [0.10-0.20x] vs 0-20% in the primary human leukocyte WT-like branch [0.80-1.00x], while leaving IFN-gamma -> JAK1/JAK2 unattenuated [0.85-1.00x]), (2) re-include X6 (RNLS-/-) to raise the beta-cell ER-stress apoptosis threshold, or (3) apply NLRC5 promoter CRISPRoff methylation or HLA-A-/- HLA-B-/- debulking (which suppress/eliminate heavy-chain flux across both IFN-alpha and IFN-gamma; AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF).

stage0_gate_0e_er_pass_criteria.pivot_rule_S5: If Gate 0E-ER fails on B2M-/- clones, apply NLRC5 CRISPRoff / K=6 HLA-A-/- HLA-B-/- ER debulking (covering both IFN-alpha and IFN-gamma), re-include X6 (RNLS-/-), or pair with TYK2 P1104A if Stage-0 confirms Type-I-IFN attenuation in human SC-beta cells.

four_mechanism_er_taxonomy_and_tyk2_p110.mechanism_1_er_heavy_chain_source_elimin: K=6 HLA-A-/- HLA-B-/- (plus HLA-C-/- in Plan A) physically eliminates orphan MHC-I heavy-chain polypeptide entry into the ER lumen, reducing orphan heavy-chain flux to 0.00x under both IFN-alpha and IFN-gamma.
four_mechanism_er_taxonomy_and_tyk2_p110.mechanism_2_transcriptional_source_suppr: NLRC5 promoter CRISPRoff silences the MHC-I enhanceosome across both Type I and Type II IFN; by contrast, TYK2 P1104A (rs34536443) selectively blunts Type-I-IFN/IL-12/IL-23 signaling while leaving IFN-gamma -> JAK1/JAK2 -> STAT1 -> IRF1 -> NLRC5 -> HLA-A/B/C transcription intact. Moreover, in primary human P1104A/P1104A leukocytes, TYK2 P1104A completely impairs IL-23 and partially impairs IL-12 but retains WT-like cellular response to high-dose IFN-alpha/beta (Boisson-Dupuis et al. 2018 PMID:30578352; whereas Howard et al. 2026 PMID:42268925 is an engineered HEK293T VAMP-seq/signaling screen and Chandra et al. 2022 PMID:36289205 studied TYK2 KO and pharmacologic TYK2i in SC-islets rather than P1104A knock-in); therefore our model tracks both the beta-cell-specific 80-90% IFN-alpha attenuation branch (modeled on TYK2i/KO in Chandra et al. 2022 PMID:36289205) and a conservative 0-20% IFN-alpha attenuation sensitivity branch (0.80-1.00x relative to WT, anchored to primary human P1104A leukocytes in Boisson-Dupuis et al. 2018 PMID:30578352) until resolved by the Stage-0 isogenic TYK2 P1104A satellite.
four_mechanism_er_taxonomy_and_tyk2_p110.mechanism_3_erad_retrotranslocation_and_: Endogenous HRD1/SEL1L/Derlin-1 ubiquitin-proteasome ERAD capacity clears misfolded B2M-free heavy chains up to the saturable beta-cell threshold alongside proinsulin and IAPP folding demand.
four_mechanism_er_taxonomy_and_tyk2_p110.mechanism_4_downstream_er_stress_apoptos: RNLS-/- raises the downstream CHOP/TXNIP apoptotic threshold against thapsigargin and cytokine stress without reducing physical heavy-chain entry into the ER lumen (Cai et al. 2020 PMID:32719542; MacDonald et al. 2025 PMID:39988068), whereas the RNLS-WT non-amyloidogenic IAPP(A25P/S28P/S29P) prime-edit challenger (ER_IAPP_PRAMLINTIDE_RNLS_WT) eliminates toxic human IAPP20-29 beta-sheet oligomers directly at the source while preserving wild-type RNLS metabolic fitness (Potter et al. 2010 PMID:20160085; Thorngren et al. 2024 PMID:38603470; Wang et al. 2014 PMID:25140605; AUDIT-REF, AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF).

b2m_ko_free_heavy_chain_surface_leakage_.mechanism: While B2M-/- eliminates canonical beta2m-assembled MHC-I heterodimers, high-affinity intracellular peptides (including high-flux preproinsulin/PPI, IGRP, and ZNT8 peptides in secretory beta cells under IFN-gamma immunoproteasome/TAP hyper-induction) can stabilize a minor fraction of beta2m-free MHC-I heavy chains or transient open conformers that escape ER quality control to the plasma membrane (Bix & Raulet 1992 J Exp Med PMID:1512546; Demaria et al. 1994 J Biol Chem PMID:8120026), and once at the cell surface, physiologic extracellular human serum beta2-microglobulin (~1.5-3.0 ug/mL, ~125-250 nM in vivo) can bind in trans to reconstitute functional peptide-presenting MHC-I complexes as established for beta2m-free MHC-I heavy chains by Vitiello et al. 1990 Science PMID:2124002, Rock et al. 1991 PNAS PMID:1986378, Bix & Raulet 1992 J Exp Med PMID:1512546, and Demaria et al. 1994 J Biol Chem PMID:8120026, and evaluated here as a Stage-0 human B2M-/- SC-islet assay gate (DEC-078).

stage0_gate_0e_er_and_0a_surface_exogeno.cytokine_and_serum_b2m_challenge_conditi: 100 U/mL IFN-gamma + 1,000 U/mL IFN-alpha + 10 ng/mL TNF-alpha for 48 h in beta2m-depleted human serum with 0, 1.5, and 3.0 ug/mL (0, 125, and 250 nM) recombinant human beta2-microglobulin add-back for 24 h (plus 20% normal human serum comparator)
stage0_gate_0e_er_and_0a_surface_exogeno.pivot_rule: If exogenous human serum beta2m (1.5-3.0 ug/mL) reconstitutes detectable W6/32 conformational staining (> 1.2x isotype), HC10/L31 free heavy-chain surface staining (> 1.2x isotype), > 5.0% primary HLA-matched T1D donor autoreactive CD8+ CTL lysis (across PPI_15-24, IGRP_265-273, and ZnT8_186-194 specificities), or > 0 endogenous HLA-A/B/C peptides by W6/32 + HC10 IP-LC-MS/MS on B2M-/- SC-beta cells, escalate to NLRC5 promoter CRISPRoff silencing or K=6 HLA-A-/- HLA-B-/- heavy-chain debulking to eliminate endogenous heavy-chain transcription at the source (AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF [DEC-044/045]).

tyk2_inducible_promoter_epistasis_prior_.mechanism: TYK2 P1104A (rs34536443) reduces IFN-alpha/beta-induced pSTAT1/pSTAT2 signaling by 80-90% in the iPSC-beta TYK2i/knockdown branch (0.15-0.35x ISRE induction; Chandra et al. 2022 PMID:36289205, which assayed TYK2 KO and pharmacologic TYK2i in SC-islets) versus 0-20% in the primary human P1104A/P1104A leukocyte WT-like high-dose IFN-alpha/beta branch (0.80-1.00x ISRE induction; Boisson-Dupuis et al. 2018 PMID:30578352; alongside the engineered HEK293T VAMP-seq/signaling screen of Howard et al. 2026 PMID:42268925) while leaving JAK1/JAK2-mediated IFN-gamma signaling largely intact (0.70-0.90x); consequently, in an early Type-I-IFN-dominated autoimmune flare (prior to heavy CD8/NK IFN-gamma release), TYK2 P1104A may attenuate ISRE-dependent transcription of Syn_5xISRE_minP -> HLA-E (Arm 1B) and endogenous CXCL10 -> SERPINB9/PD-L1 (Locus 3) unless paired with constitutive/basal-floor promoters.
tyk2_inducible_promoter_epistasis_prior_.architectural_coupling_rule: Any candidate combining TYK2 P1104A (X4) with B2M-/- or Locus 3 must pair X4 with constitutive/basal-floor promoters (Arm 1X EEF1A1 -> HLA-E and L3-BF-B basal-floor SERPINB9) unless Stage-0 co-primary interaction estimands beta_{X1 x X4} and beta_{X3 x X4} and the 3x2 TYK2 x L3-BF-B satellite confirm >= 70% shield induction under combined IFN-alpha (1,000 U/mL) + low IFN-gamma (10 U/mL) (AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF).

coupled_five_transgene_hypoxic_isr_surfa.mechanism: Under acute 72 h post-implant hypoxia (pO2 <= 5 mmHg in oversize >100 um clusters or stagnant >100 um seroma fluid films) combined with IL-1beta + IFN-gamma + TNF-alpha ER stress, PERK-eIF2alpha phosphorylation attenuates global cap-dependent 5'-m7G translation by f_ISR in [0.15, 0.35] across all 5 engineered cap-dependent transgenes simultaneously (CD47-IgV-GPI, HLA-E SCT, PD-L1, SERPINB9, and iCasp9), rather than SERPINB9 alone.

post_72h_hypoxic_isr_stressed_single_cel.mandatory_72h_stressed_single_cell_p10_q: Stage-0 Gate 0A-surface / Gate 0E-ER requires that the 10th-percentile single-cell floor (p10 >= 180,000 CD47 molecules/cell and p10 >= 15,000 HLA-E molecules/cell) hold not only at resting Hour 0 (obs_cd47_p10_single_cell_molecules >= 180,000) but also after 72 h of 2% O2 hypoxia + cytokine stress (obs_hypoxic_72h_cd47_p10_single_cell_molecules >= 180,000 and obs_hypoxic_72h_hlae_p10_single_cell_molecules >= 15,000, both required for READY_FOR_ENCAPSULATION_COMPLETE_STAGE0_EVIDENCE): at the default Layer-2 prior (Hour-0 CD47 mean 238,004 -> 72-h mean 183,354 [183,410 exact] at f_ISR = 0.75) with unmitigated sigma_ln = 0.45, the 72-h single-cell p10 is 93,081 [93,109 exact] molecules/cell with 57.30% [57.27%] of cells below 180,000; similarly, for HLA-E (t_1/2 = 14 h, R_HLAE = 0.854247 at f_ISR = 0.85), Arm 1X Hour-0 mean 22,000 yields 72-h mean 18,793 and 72-h p10 = 12,622 (< 15,000) at sigma_ln = 0.28, requiring Hour-0 HLA-E mean >= 26,144 molecules/cell at sigma_ln = 0.28 (or sigma_ln <= 0.1653 at Hour-0 mean 22,000). Clearing 72-h p10 >= 180,000 (CD47) and >= 15,000 (HLA-E) requires monoclonal UCOE/cHS4 variegation tightening + top-expression MCB sorting (Hour-0 CD47 >= 320,000-366,000 and Hour-0 HLA-E >= 26,144 at sigma_ln <= 0.28, f_ISR = 0.85; AUDIT-REF, AUDIT-REF, AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF [DEC-050/051/052]).

architectural_mitigations: Primary biotransport mitigation: enforce DX-b <= 80-100 um cluster diameter cap + 1,500 IEQ/cm^2 low-load modular omental cassette so intra-cluster pO2 remains >= 15 mmHg across 336 h (keeping f_ISR >= 0.85 and preventing hypoxic PERK-eIF2alpha activation).

Molecular 5'-leader backup coupon (Gate 0A/0E): test ISR-resistant BiP/HSPA5 5'-UTR IRES or uORF-bypass leader (Starck et al. 2016 PMID:26823435) on antisense CD47-IgV and sense HLA-E SCT in Arm 1X-ISR if 72 h 2% O2 + thapsigargin retention drops below 180,000 CD47 or 15,000 HLA-E molecules/cell.

joint_five_transgene_72h_hypoxic_isr_sin.correlated_ribosomal_er_bottleneck_ratio: Under 72-h 1% O2 + 16.7 mM glucose + IFN-g/TNF-a/IL-1b stress, marginal p10 >= threshold on individual transgenes allows up to 1 - 0.90^5 = 40.95% of cells to fail at least one shield/safety axis under independence; Stage-0 Gate 0A/0C/0S therefore enforces a single-cell 5-color flow + prime-flow/intracellular joint coverage gate requiring >= 90% of live beta cells (lower95 >= 0.90, matching the Frechet lower bound 1 - 5*(1 - 0.98) = 0.90 for 98% per-transgene marginal coverage) to simultaneously clear all 5 thresholds (obs_hypoxic_72h_five_transgene_joint_above_threshold_fraction >= 0.90; MW-R6-S1-08 & R7S2-F01 [DEC-053/055/057]).
joint_five_transgene_72h_hypoxic_isr_sin.bip_hspa5_leader_proteotoxicity_qualific: Constitutive BiP/HSPA5 uORF-bypass leader rescue (L3-BF-B+BiP) must simultaneously clear Gate 0E ER proteostasis without driving secretory ER crowding: proinsulin-to-insulin molar ratio <= 0.15, CHOP/DDIT3 fold <= 1.5x, XBP1s/XBP1u ratio <= 1.5x, and GSIS SI >= 2.5.

donor_slc30a8_znt8_precautionary_hold.proposed_challenger_study_advancement_co: Any optional donor SLC30A8 challenger study (distinct from established Blueprint A/X release thresholds) must predeclare: (1) absolute viable Stage-7 INS+/NKX6-1+ cell yield per starting hPSC across independent differentiation blocks (never percentage among survivors alone), (2) the 12-week in-vivo stimulated human C-peptide model, implanted starting-cell/IEQ dose denominator, justified non-inferiority margin, and one-sided confidence criterion (never a pilot point estimate >= 90% or non-significant p-value), and (3) full retention of Readout 2 dynamic low-glucose shut-off (t50 and t90), basal secretion, glucagon counterregulation, and cellular OCR headroom gates (GY-003, GY-004, GY-007).

endogenous_intracellular_cd59_iris_secre.qualification_scope: Endogenous CD59 remains unedited so non-GPI-anchored intracellular isoforms (IRIS-1/IRIS-2) required for SNARE-mediated insulin granule exocytosis are preserved and verified via Readout 2 dynamic GSIS/C-peptide perifusion separately from Readout 3C cell-surface GPI-anchored complement (C3b/C5b-9) lysis attribution.

post_adjunct_depletion_three_history_qua.protocol_summary: Blocked sibling-aliquot three-history Stage-0 rechallenge on existing exact Stage-7 preparations without new genomic edits: ARM1_NEVER_CONDITIONED vs ARM2_CONDITIONED_DEPLETED (verified carrier-bound + cell-free supernatant SA-FasL and SA-THBD bioactivity depleted below predeclared assay LLOD/depletion limits, matched contemporaneous sham/age handling, declared adjunct_sa_fhl1_status preventing active SA-FHL-1 lots from being misclassified as complete adjunct depletion, non-pooled NATURAL_AGING_DECAY vs PHYSICAL_WASHOUT depletion modes, and explicit RETAINED_CONDITIONED_RESPONDERS vs FRESH_RECIPIENT_RESPONDERS / MHC-II CD4+ vs MHC-I CD8+ cross-presentation separation) vs ARM3_CONTINUOUSLY_ACTIVE (directly verified ongoing functional bioactivity; noting Headen 2018 PMID:29867165 reported 3.0 +/- 0.8 d fluorescent SA-FasL retention rather than functional bioactivity half-life and used transient systemic rapamycin).

ectopic_cd55_scr14_unconfounded_satellit.primary_causal_contrast: Exact same edited graft background + ectopic CD55(SCR1-4) (with declared GPI vs TM anchor, surface localization, QuantiBRITE density, and PIGK GPI-biosynthesis non-competition against CD47-IgV-GPI and endogenous CD59) vs exact same edited graft background without ectopic CD55 under matched delivery/mock treatment and intact endogenous CD59; unedited WT (already complement-resistant in mature endocrine cells per van der Torren 2017 PMID:27787618) and CD59 loss-of-function (confounded by IRIS-1/2 SNARE secretion loss per Golec 2022 PMID:35666870) serve strictly as supplementary references alongside the existing Layer-3 CD47-CD55 / 2A-free CD55+CD59 challenger.

held_challenger_state_machine.promotion_guard: Never triggers automatic or silent promotion into Scenario A, Scenario B, or Challenger X; requires independent multi-clone, multi-differentiation-block, and multi-donor confirmation plus a separate follow-on IIP.

held_challenger_families.transcript_and_locus_reconciliation: Reconciles live Ensembl ENST00000323274.15 vs .9 (Exon 1 chr18:657653-657947, CDS start chr18:657743, antisense ENOSF1 ENSG00000132199 start chr18:667671; chr18:657600-658000 spans noncoding sequence and is a target window rather than an exact KO allele; Tummala et al. 2022 PMID:35931051 established ENOSF1-to-TYMS suppression rather than proving exon-5 KO damages ENOSF1). Nuclease TYMS KO adds a K chromosomal cut rather than a B base edit under GY-006; biallelic pan-lineage AAVS1 iCasp9 remains mandatory and functionally verified (GY-002); arrest across 0.1-20 uM supplemented 2'-deoxythymidine (dThd) is framed as an aggressive salvage-vulnerability falsifier (Sartori-Maldonado et al. 2024 PMID:38867450 rescued KO proliferation at 20 uM dThd and noted dying-cell salvage and 3D residual growth), paired with dTTP/dUTP balance, >=63,000x duplex-seq/CAST-seq, and shared iEC/iPericyte vascular bank checks.

held_challenger_families.qualification_requirements: Must name the exact Design-B background modified (scored 6-locus ISLET1_CHASSIS_B_HLA_C_RETAINED_6LOCUS_HYPOTHESIS vs unscored B'-SCT molecular hypotheses), quantify HLA-A, HLA-B, and retained HLA-C separately alongside trans HLA-E, PD-L1, and cis CETP, and test matched KIR-defined (NKG2A+, NKG2C+, KIR2DL1/2/3+, KIR3DL1+) primary NK subsets under Playbook absolute lysis ceilings (never generic CD56+ survival; GY-001, GY-005); notes >=75% HLA-A/B reduction with >=80% HLA-C/HLA-E/PD-L1 retention is an aspirational engineering gate given ~50% HLA-I reduction under near-complete NLRC5 knockdown in Szymczak et al. 2022 PMID:36103539.

Notes Rao et al. 2026 PMID:42856285 is a non-peer-reviewed September 2026 bioRxiv preprint and neither Rao 2026 PMID:42856285 nor Yan et al. 2023 PMID:37175900 tested +6A>T (which could impair protective PD-L1). Requires isoform-specific junction assays distinguishing endogenous Ex3-included vs Ex2->Ex4 skipped transcripts and endogenous surface/secreted PD-L1 contribution from the intronless Locus-3 PD-L1 cDNA cassette, undisturbed cis PDCD1LG2, and functional PD-1 engagement (GY-001, GY-006, GY-008).

Tested strictly as individual B = 1 single-allele experiments (never multiplexed B >= 3; GY-006), noting Bradley et al. 2026 PMID:42120510 studied 48-h 1% O2 dysfunction in larger SC-islets without TXNIP editing or reoxygenation. Requires matched cluster-size controls across 48-h 1% O2 plus reoxygenation recovery, absolute viable INS+NKX6-1+ beta-cell recovery per starting input, alpha/delta survival, basal insulin secretion, dynamic GSIS, low-glucose shut-off (t50 and t90), and OCR without waiving G6PC2/RNLS or Layer-4 oxygen-budget gates (GY-003, GY-004).
